Data Services

Globus

Globus is research cyberinfrastructure, developed and operated as a not-for-profit service by the University of Chicago.

With Globus, you can easily, reliably and securely move, share, & discover data no matter where it lives – from the REANNZ High Performance Computing platform, a lab cluster, tape archive, public cloud or laptop.

Using Globus, you can access and manage all your data, even protected data, from anywhere, using your existing identities, with just a web browser.​

Find out more about Globus

Filesender

FileSender simplifies the file-sharing process through a straightforward interface. Users can upload up to 1,000 files (up to 5 Terabytes in total) and in any format.  Encryption protocols ensure that files only reach their intended recipients – and no one else.

Find out more about FileSender
